nl.title: Testen van restores vóór je ze nodig hebt
nl.excerpt: Backup/restore met JetBackup of DirectAdmin Create/Restore Backups.
nl.bodyHtml:
“Testen van restores vóór je ze nodig hebt”: maak of herstel via JetBackup / DirectAdmin backups. Kies files, databases of full; test daarna de site.

Voorbereiding

  • DirectAdmin-login
  • Welk herstelpunt
  • Of mail/DNS meegaat

Stappen

  1. Log in op DirectAdmin → JetBackup of Create/Restore Backups.
  2. Voor backup: selecteer home, databases, e-mail en/of cron; start de job; wacht tot Completed.
  3. Voor restore: kies datum/type; restore selectief (alleen DB of alleen files) als dat veiliger is.
  4. Na restore: leeg caches; test homepage, wp-admin en een kritieke flow.
  5. Controleer schijfruimte — oude backups opruimen volgens retentie.

Controleren

  • Backup Completed of site werkt na restore

Tip: Selectieve restore verkleint risico t.o.v. full overwrite.

Let op: Restore overschrijft live data — bevestig het juiste account.

Kom je er niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld je domeinnaam, wat je al hebt geprobeerd en eventuele foutmeldingen (tekst of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: File Manager, MySQL, SSL.

en.title: Test restores before you need them
en.excerpt: Test restores before you need them: steps in the VPS via SSH or the provider console for test, restores, before.
en.bodyHtml:
For Test restores before you need them follow a targeted checklist in the VPS via SSH or the provider console. Core themes: test, restores, before.

Preparation

  • Access to the VPS via SSH or the provider console
  • Focus of this article: test, restores, before
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Sign in to the VPS via SSH or the provider console. Filter or search for parts that belong to test, restores, before.
  2. Confirm SSH or console access; take a snapshot for risky steps around test.
  3. Connect and inventory current state (services, ports, disk) before changing restores.
  4. Apply only the planned server change for “Test restores before you need them”.
  5. Restart only the affected service; test reachability from outside.
  6. Confirm what the backup includes (files/DB/mail) for test, restores, before and where the offsite copy lives.
  7. Where possible run a restore test to a safe target before overwriting production.

Verify

  • Result for test, restores, before matches “Test restores before you need them”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside test restores before
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get test, restores, before right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if test, restores, before touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: the VPS via SSH or the provider console, backups, tickets.
